canonicalContract.contractRule: canonicalComponents[] lists rev1-permitted canonical targets for each artifact. The overlay may consume the canonical ontology; it cannot mutate or negotiate with it.

gatePolicy.purpose: Certify already-published Whirlpool TL overlay knowledge against frozen top_load_washer rev1. This is not new compounding.
gatePolicy.canonicalImmutabilityRule: top_load_washer.json rev1 must remain byte-stable before and after publish.
gatePolicy.promotionAuthorityRule: Gate table is authoritative; compiler ledger is audit-only.
gatePolicy.isolationRule: Do not import Whirlpool FL washer overlay vocabulary, topology, or aliases.
gatePolicy.driveRoutingRule: No drive_system canonical routing. Drive diagnostics route control_board -> drive_motor -> motor_output_test with transmission_or_shifter functional and mode_shifter overlay implementation.
gatePolicy.lidAuthorizationRule: Matcher-derived door_lock -> lid_lock. Procedure-derived lid switch role may certify lid_switch. Ambiguous general lid-lock language defers; do not fabricate lid_switch matcher aliases.
gatePolicy.overlayOnlyRule: mode_shifter, splutch, clutch, gearcase, recirc_pump, bulk_level_switch remain overlay implementation — not canonical expansion.

layerDefinitions.canonical_functional: rev1-permitted canonical target(s) for the artifact.
layerDefinitions.overlay_implementation: OEM implementation component implementing a canonical function.
layerDefinitions.matcher_derived: Seed/matcher vocabulary mapped to canonical without procedure-role inference.
layerDefinitions.procedure_role_evidence: Explicit OEM procedure text distinguishes functional roles.
layerDefinitions.ambiguous_lid_language: General lid-lock OEM title without role disambiguation.
layerDefinitions.deferred_binding: Known OEM procedure not yet bound in published overlay.
